SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Weather and Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather and Climate as rumours only.
   B. Explain Weather and Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Weather and Climate never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate.

2. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Location, Position and Size of Kenya.
   C. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)

   D. Nairobi

7. Which statement about African Traditional Education is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing African Traditional Education.
   C. Say African Traditional Education never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

9. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Development of Transport never happens in Kenya.

   D. Treat Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi as rumours only.

13. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

14. Which statement about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

15. Which statement about The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.

   D. Treat The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui as rumours only.
